people.name: Tarek Al-Halabi
people.description: Head chef. Tall, wearing a white double-breasted chef coat with rolled-up sleeves, dark trousers, white skullcap, well-trimmed beard. Often near the pass or hot line directing plating.

people.name: Yara Karam
people.description: Sous chef. Medium height, white chef coat (single-breasted), black apron, hair tied back with a white bandana. Floats between stations.

people.name: Bashir Naim
people.description: Grill cook. Black apron over a black t-shirt + black baseball cap. Always at the grill / mixed-grill station with tongs.

people.name: Rana Saad
people.description: Pastry chef. White coat + pink apron, hair under a white cap. Works at the pastry / dessert station with knafeh and baklava.

people.name: Joud Mansour
people.description: Prep cook. Black t-shirt + black apron, blue disposable gloves while chopping. At the prep table or near the walk-in cooler.

people.name: Eyad Rifai
people.description: Dishwasher. Black rubber apron, yellow gloves, always at the dish station behind a conveyor dishwasher.

actions.label: Preparing sandwiches
actions.description: Building sandwiches/wraps: cutting bread, assembling fillings, wrapping in paper or grilling on a panini press.

actions.label: Cleaning station
actions.description: Wiping a worktop with a cloth, spraying sanitiser, mopping the floor, scrubbing a station, taking out trash.

actions.label: Grilling meat
actions.description: Turning skewers, kebabs or burgers on a charcoal/gas grill; flipping shawarma meat on a vertical rotisserie.

actions.label: Plating dishes at the pass
actions.description: Arranging food on a plate at the pass/expediter window for service, garnishing, wiping plate rims, calling tickets.

actions.label: Mise-en-place / prep work
actions.description: Chopping vegetables, deboning chicken, portioning rice into containers, restocking the line, weighing ingredients.

actions.label: Pastry / dessert work
actions.description: Rolling pastry, layering knafeh, piping cream, dusting sugar, arranging baklava trays.

actions.label: Washing dishes
actions.description: Loading or unloading the conveyor dishwasher, hand-scrubbing pots in a sink, racking glassware.

actions.label: Idle / off-task
actions.description: Standing around not actively working — phone in hand, leaning on a counter, chatting away from their station.
